method: Synthetic controls authored through ExcelDocument; opened without repair, F9 recalculated, saved as XLSX; first cohort saved as XML Spreadsheet through native Save As. Existing manual calculation preference retained. No native settings changed.
limits: Native saved cache references qualify the included formulas and coercion cases. XML producer fixture is a simple worksheet, not broad XML appearance qualification.
preservationMethod: OfficeIMO XLSX control saved as XML through native Excel; OfficeIMO XML export independently opened without repair and saved as XLSX. Both saved URLs observed. App closed after each cohort. No global settings changed.
preservationLimits: Native Excel quantizes the custom RGB font color to indexed color 56 when reading XML. Fill, medium dashed border, bold/italic, rotation, formula hiding, merge, hyperlink tooltip, names and page settings are retained by the corrected consumer cohort. Native XML geometry control uses observed eight-pixel column digit width. Not a general pixel-fidelity claim.
